parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "claude-haiku-4-5",
  "max_tokens": 400,
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "You classify email replies from MedSpa prospects and clients. Return ONLY raw JSON, no markdown, no preamble.

Reply from: {{ $('Parse Reply').first().json.senderEmail }}
Subject: {{ $('Parse Reply').first().json.subject.replace(/"/g, '\"').replace(/
/g, ' ') }}
Body: {{ $('Parse Reply').first().json.body.replace(/"/g, '\"').replace(/
/g, ' ') }}

Classify into ONE class (pick strongest signal):
- HOT — explicit ready to book ("send me a time", "let's schedule", "yes")
- WARM — engaged but needs info ("how does it compare", "what's pricing", "tell me more")
- OBJECTION — interested but real blocker ("too expensive", "already have provider", "HIPAA concerns")
- NOT_NOW — wrong timing ("reach out in 3 months", "Q4 is bad")
- REFERRAL — knows someone else ("try my friend at X")
- UNSUBSCRIBE — hard opt-out ("remove me", "stop", "unsubscribe", "do not email")
- BAD_FIT — not the ICP ("we're too big", "solo esthetician at home")
- COMPLAINT — escalation ("reporting to attorney", "spam", "shame")
- AUTO_REPLY — OOO/vacation autoresponder — do NOT engage

Return this exact JSON:
{
  "class": "HOT" | ... | "AUTO_REPLY",
  "confidence": "high" | "medium" | "low",
  "oneLineSummary": "...",
  "suggestedResponse": "Owner action or drafted reply (1-2 sentences)",
  "urgencyMinutes": 0-1440
}"
  }]
}

value.Requested Action: ={{ $json.replyClass === 'HOT' ? 'Book appointment' : $json.replyClass === 'WARM' ? 'Send more info' : $json.replyClass === 'OBJECTION' ? 'Address objection' : $json.replyClass === 'UNSUBSCRIBE' ? 'Remove from list' : $json.replyClass === 'COMPLAINT' ? 'Escalate to owner' : $json.replyClass === 'REFERRAL' ? 'Follow up on referral' : 'Review manually' }}

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.replyClass === 'COMPLAINT' ? '🚨 URGENT COMPLAINT' : ($json.replyClass === 'HOT' ? '🔥 HOT REPLY' : ($json.replyClass === 'UNSUBSCRIBE' ? '🚫 Unsubscribe' : '⚠ Reply needs attention')) }}: {{ $json.clientName }}
